text:
**Best value under $1,000: ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400 W panel kit.** The listing gives it **1,024 Wh of LiFePO₄ capacity, an 1,800 W inverter, and a 400 W panel for $698**—the largest panel in the under-$1,000 options surfaced, which is useful when you want to recharge during an outage. The catch: it’s listed as a **pre-order**, with shipping from Dec. 7. [Check the listing and buy link](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup).

**Need a kit sooner?** Consider the [BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit), listed at $729 before a listed coupon. It’s also identified as a home-backup pick in this [under-$1,000 roundup](https://www.wpa-pool.com/best-solar-generators-under-1000/).

Either is for **essential appliances and devices, not powering an entire house**; a roughly 1 kWh station is a modest backup, not a whole-home battery. [More on what sub-$1,000 units can handle](https://www.haynet.net/best-solar-generators-under-1000-dollars/).
